summary: Holley Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to announce the appointment of Sarah Apple as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary, effective May 15, 2026, replacing Carly Kennedy who departed to pursue other opportunities. The filing describes Ms. Apple's compensation terms, including a $350,000 base salary, 50% target bonus, a $25,000 signing bonus, and relocation reimbursement. This is a routine executive hire-and-departure disclosure, not an abrupt or forced management change constituting a special situation event. No transaction, strategic review, or shareholder action is involved.
